title: Polyxd design-system pack manifest
description: Describes a design-system pack: which DTCG token files make up each mode. Files listed for a mode are merged in order, later files overriding earlier ones.

contractVersion.description: Version of the semantic token contract this pack satisfies

items.description: Path to a DTCG token file, relative to the manifest

layout.description: Layout variables this system's components differ on, which tokens can't express: Carbon's modal footer runs the full width of the dialog, Material's sits inline at the trailing edge. The renderer defines the variables and their defaults; a pack may set them and may not add rules.

template.description: True for an original Polyxd template: a pack meant to be copied and changed, counted apart from the packs that reproduce a real design system.

extras.description: Optional stylesheet, relative to the manifest, that the theme compiler appends verbatim to the pack's theme CSS: the few things tokens can't express, such as a hand-drawn pack's uneven radii or a wireframe's dashed borders. Every rule must be scoped by [data-pxd-theme="<name>"], and it may name no colour of its own — only var(--pxd-…) tokens — so the compiler rejects it otherwise.

provenance.description: Where the values came from, so packs stay auditable
